identity.name: E1_Article_Writer
principles: Fusion: Editorial Serif elegance mixed with SaaS functional density
Emotion: Writing is intimate; the UI must feel calm and focused (Zen Mode)
Content is King: The article editor is the stage; everything else is backstage
Negative Space: Massive margins in the editor to simulate a printed page

usage.editor_bg: #FFFFFF (Pure White) - Distinct from the dashboard background.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use a subtle noise texture on the main background (opacity 0.02) to mimic paper.

layout_strategies.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B): Dense, data-rich, but with 'Stone' aesthetic. Sharp corners.
layout_strategies.editor: Zen Mode: Center column, distraction-free. Toolbar floats or sticks to top.
layout_strategies.landing: Asymmetric Editorial: Large serif typography, overlapping images, generous whitespace.

hero_workspace.usage: Landing page hero section, right side or background with overlay

motion.loading: Use a skeleton loader with a 'shimmer' effect (bg-stone-200) instead of spinners where possible.
motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -10 }} transition={{ duration: 0.3 }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #1C1917 on #FAFAF9 or #FFFFFF. Use #78716C for secondary text, not lighter.
accessibility.aria: All interactive elements must have aria-labels if no text is present.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid warm greys or white.
Do NOT use rounded corners > 4px. Prefer sharp (0px) or very subtle (2px) for this 'Editorial' look.
Center the Article Editor content, but keep the Dashboard full-width with padding.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1, H2, H3. Use 'Manrope' for UI text. Use 'Merriweather' for the actual article content area.
Always add data-testid to interactive elements.
Never use generic AI emojis. Use Lucide icons.
If a user asks for a 'Save' button, place it in a sticky header in the editor.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a SaaS for writers. The aesthetic is 'The New York Times meets Linear'. It should feel prestigious, not like a cheap tool. Use the provided image URLs for the landing page. Implement the 'Zen Mode' editor with high priority - it should feel like a clean sheet of paper.
